question.nlq: Hey there! I'm trying to get a handle on our cancellation rates. Could you show me the number of cancelled orders broken down by the customer's payment method for the whole year of 2018? I'd really appreciate it if you could break that down nicely for me!

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    c.payment_method,
    COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM Actual_Orders ao
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Customers c ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Cancel'
    AND strftime('%Y', ao.actual_order_date) = '2018'
GROUP BY c.payment_method

question.nlq: Please list the names of delivery routes that have delivered more than two distinct products, together with the count of distinct products delivered on each route.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT dr.route_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT aop.product_id) AS distinct_product_count
FROM Order_Deliveries od
JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations drl ON od.location_code = drl.location_code
JOIN Delivery_Routes dr ON drl.route_id = dr.route_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON od.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
GROUP BY dr.route_id, dr.route_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT aop.product_id) > 2;

meanings.gt_sql: SELECT "Delivery_Routes"."route_name" AS "route_name", COUNT(*) AS "total_deliveries" FROM "Delivery_Routes" JOIN "Delivery_Route_Locations" ON "Delivery_Routes"."route_id" = "Delivery_Route_Locations"."route_id" JOIN "Order_Deliveries" ON "Delivery_Route_Locations"."location_code" = "Order_Deliveries"."location_code" GROUP BY "Delivery_Routes"."route_name";

SELECT dr.route_name,
       COUNT(od.actual_order_id) AS total_deliveries
FROM Delivery_Routes dr
LEFT JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations drl ON dr.route_id = drl.route_id
LEFT JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON drl.location_code = od.location_code

ORDER BY dr.route_name;
